Pawan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023
Author: Anil Verma
Bench: Anil Verma
1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH
AT INDORE
BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE ANIL VERMA  ON THE 19 th OF SEPTEMBER, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 39021 of 2023
BETWEEN:-
 PAWAN S/O MUKHTIYAR SINGH, AGED ABOUT 31  Y E A R S , OCCUPATION: LABOR, R/O: VILLAGE  UMARKUA, TEHSIL DAHI, DISTT. DHAR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI MITESH PATIDAR - ADVOCATE)
AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH STATION HOUSE  OFFICER THROUGH POLICE STATION KUKSHI,
 DISTRICT DHAR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .
(BY SHRI SUHAS PUNDLIK - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
opennyai_summary.19_September_2023__facts:
ORDER Applicant has filed this third bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 on behalf of the applicant for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.163/2015 registered at P.S. Kukshi, District Dhar (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 366,
376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
He is in jail since 27.06.2023.
2.
On 22.03.2015, FIR has been registered under Section 363 of IPC against the unknown person.
During the investigation, prosecutrix was recovered from the possession of the present applicant and it has been gathered that present applicant abducted the prosecutrix and repeatedly committed rape upon her.
Accordingly, a case has been registered against the applicant.
He is a permanent resident of District Dhar.
After his repeated arrest prosecutrix (PW-2) and her mother (PW-3) have been examined before the trial Court and both of them have turned hostile and have not stated anything against the present applicant.
opennyai_summary.19_September_2023__arguments:
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent person and he has been falsely implicated in this matter.
4. Per-contra, learned counsel for respondent/State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection by submitting that applicant has misused the liberty given to him, therefore, he does not deserve for bail.
opennyai_summary.19_September_2023__decision:
Under the above circumstances,
prayer for grant of bail may be considered on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.
In these circumstances, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.
7. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.
He shall abide by the conditions enumerated u/S. 437(3) Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
opennyai_summary.19_September_2023__ANALYSIS: Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, nature and gravity of allegation as also taking note of the fact that prosecutrix (PW-2) has categorically stated before the trial Court that present applicant neither abducted nor committed any rape upon her; her mother (PW-3) has also deposed in the same manner; applicant has already suffered jail incarceration of 2 years and has been sufficiently punished for his default of non-appearance and final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.

opennyai_summary.16_April_2024__facts:
This is first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.446/2022 dated : 30/7/2022 registered at P.S. - Kannod District - Dewas for offences punishable under Sections 363, 366(A), 346, 376(2)(N), 34 of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
2. As per prosecution case, the prosecutrix was living with the applicant for last two years in relationship and out of that relationship she got pregnant and delivered a child.
Since she was minor, offence has been registered.
opennyai_summary.16_April_2024__arguments:
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that as per the statement of the prosecutrix under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, she herself had been living with the applicant and made physical relationship.
She has Pawan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74270750/
1 delivered a child and both got married.
opennyai_summary.16_April_2024__ANALYSIS: 5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the statement of the prosecutrix that she has herself made relationship with the applicant and they got married and she also delivered a child, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of bail.
opennyai_summary.16_April_2024__decision:
6. It is directed that applicant Pawan shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.
7. A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.
8. With the aforesaid, the application is allowed and disposed off.

2.  This is the second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of CR.P.C. for grant of bail.

registered at Police Station-Chandan Nagar District-Indore for the offence under Section 363, 376,

opennyai_summary.12_November_2024__decision:

Conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.

opennyai_summary.6_February_2025__facts:
This is third bail application filed under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C, 1973) for grant of bail during trial relating to Crime No.772/2023 dated (not mentioned), registered at Police Station-Raipuriya, District-Jhabua for the offence under Sections 376(3), 376(2)(n) of IPC, 1860 and under section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 07.02.2024.
Earlier, first bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to renew the prayer either after statement of the prsoecutirx or after two months.
2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that of commission of rape upon the prosecutrix.
opennyai_summary.6_February_2025__arguments: It is further submitted that since, the prosecutrix is not turning for her statements before the trial Court, her statements could not be recorded till date however, the statements of her parents have been recorded and they have turned hostile and have not supported the case of the prosecution.
opennyai_summary.6_February_2025__decision:
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
6. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the rival submissions of the counsel for the parties, custody period of the applicant and statements of witnesses, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.
7. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his/her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.
It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
8.
This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
Certified Copy as per rules.
